name: Razormane Grounds
summary: Razormane quilboar push east from the Barrens into central Durotar. Their thorn-choked camp marks the front of their unending clash with Orgrimmar's orcs.

sections.title: A Thorn in Durotar's Side
sections.body: At the Southfury River, the Razormane Grounds threaten travelers beneath central Durotar's red cliffs. The camp marks the furthest east the quilboar have spread from the Barrens. Captain Flat Tusk of the Battleguard and Geolord Mottle lead raids on nearby orc settlements and passing supply lines. Patrols set out from Razor Hill and nearby outposts, but the Razormane keep replenishing their ranks among the briars faster than the Horde can clear them.

faq.answer: The Razormane Grounds are a fortified quilboar camp in central Durotar, where the Razormane push east from the Barrens.

faq.q: Why are the quilboar attacking Durotar?
faq.answer: The Razormane see neighboring lands as theirs and seek to expand their thorny thickets and hunting grounds at the expense of the Horde's new settlements.

faq.q: Who leads the quilboar at the Razormane Grounds?
faq.answer: Captain Flat Tusk leads the Razormane Battleguard, alongside Geolord Mottle, an earth-shaping geomancer.

faq.q: Why are there so many bones around the camp?
faq.answer: The Razormane hunt and scavenge aggressively, stripping local wildlife to the bone to feed their raiders and leaving the carcasses around the camp as markers of their territory.

angles.text: For orcs in Durotar, the Razormane Grounds threaten the heart of their new homeland. Young warriors prove their mettle by culling the quilboar.
For the Horde, suppressing the Razormane Grounds helps secure travel and supply lines between the Barrens and Orgrimmar.
